sections.heading: Mother Dairy's Dankuni Plant and the Kolkata Market
paragraphs: In April 2022 PTI, carried by DairyNews7x7, reported that Mother Dairy Fruit & Vegetable, a wholly owned subsidiary of the National Dairy Development Board, was selling ice cream, curd and butter in 10 West Bengal districts and meant to reach 20 within five years, with outlets rising from roughly 17,000 to more than 30,000.

The company said its Dankuni plant in Hooghly district was running at 40 per cent of capacity and would be lifted to 60 per cent that fiscal year. It set a value-added products turnover target of Rs 170 to 175 crore for 2022-23 and Rs 500 crore by 2026-27, and its 400 g mishti doi was then priced at Rs 70. With Mother Dairy running Dankuni and Amul building at Sankrail, the Kolkata region now has two large cultured-product plants on either bank of the Hooghly.

sections.heading: Amul's Curd Plant at Sankrail Food Park, Howrah, Near Kolkata
paragraphs: During the Bengal Global Business Summit 2025, PTI reported in The Tribune, GCMMF committed Rs 600 crore to an integrated dairy at Sankrail Food Park in Howrah near Kolkata. The Kaira District Cooperative Milk Producers Union of Anand is building it in two phases.

Managing director Jayen Mehta said the site would hold the world's largest curd-making facility at 10 lakh kg a day, within total milk processing of 15 lakh litres a day, because Bengali households strongly prefer tok doi and mishti doi. Amul already sells more than 10 lakh litres of fresh milk a day in the state and buys milk in 14 districts from over 1.2 lakh women producers.

sections.heading: Matching Tube Finish to Kolkata Product Lines
paragraphs: Curd setting and incubation, mishti doi, ice cream mix and butter circuits are where cultured protein and milk fat hold on to the bore, so for those lines we suggest 316L tube to ASTM A270 with an SF4 electropolished finish. An Ra report travels with every electropolished lot, together with an EN 10204 3.1 certificate that ties each length back to its heat number.

Raw milk reception, pasteuriser utilities, chilled water and CIP return pipework rarely justify an electropolished bore, and 304L in SF1 or mill finish keeps a Hooghly or Howrah expansion budget under control.

sections.heading: What to Send With a Kolkata Enquiry
bullets: Section the tube is for: milk reception, curd and mishti doi, ice cream, butter or CIP
Outside diameters and wall thicknesses you need, and the running metres of each
Grade and internal finish per line: 316L at SF4, or 304L at SF1 or mill finish
Governing standard (ASTM A270, ASTM A269 or ASME BPE) and the highest Ra you will accept
Any tri-clamp ferrules, bends, tees or reducers you want priced in the same quotation

sections.heading: Delivery to Kolkata, Howrah and Hooghly
paragraphs: Orders for Kolkata go out from Mumbai by road, each electropolished length capped at both ends and sleeved, and we put the dispatch date and transit time in writing when the order is confirmed. Every length is PMI-checked before loading, and once an enquiry is complete you receive a quotation within 24 hours.
